name: Alphalete - SEO AEO Audit 2026-06-23
body:
> Audit · Alphalete · 2026-06-23

# Summary
Two June audits moved into this folder in the Oct 1 reorganization: a full read-only SEO/AEO audit with a prioritized fix list (local-seo-auditor, June 23) and a sampled AEO/GEO grading of 15 location pages. At the time the site ran Yoast with LiteSpeed on Hostinger.

# Key findings (June 23 audit)
- Sitemap reachable and valid (Yoast `sitemap_index.xml`): `page-sitemap.xml` had 238 URLs including 133 `/service-areas/` pages; `post-sitemap.xml` had 19 posts.
- The June 11 indexing crisis (3 of 244 indexed) was no longer a crawl block: robots.txt allowed all and sampled pages were 200, self-canonical, index/follow. Remaining issue framed as quality and freshness.
- **Duplicate H1 resolved:** every sampled page had exactly one H1 and `cdp-text-overlay` appeared zero times; the copy-delete-posts overlay "appears to have been deactivated".
- Biggest risk: thin near-duplicate programmatic pages plus off-target Denver-metro pages after a Colorado Springs retarget.
- P0: off-target Denver-metro pages still indexable; `/404-2/` and `/privacy-policy-2/` indexable and sitemapped; confirm GSC coverage and only re-request money pages.
- P1: homepage missing meta description; homepage schema Organization-only without NAP; 3 location templates missing FAQ and LocalBusiness schema; blog H1 styled as h3 with ` ` junk from a sliding-headline widget; no llms.txt.

# AEO/GEO sample (15 pages)
- 133 location pages in the sitemap (Hydro 45, Trenchless 44, Drain 44).
- Grades: 12 "Yellow mostly", 3 "Orange partial" (Monument hydro, Colorado Springs drain, Monument drain had no visible FAQ or FAQ schema).
- Every sampled page had 2 H1s by this script's count and 129 to 148 internal links.

# Decisions and status
- Hand-offs named: wordpress-elementor-engineer (noindex/redirect, schema/FAQ parity, H1 fix), seo-blog-writer (unique city copy), Kim (GSC checks, keep/kill list).
- Several items were superseded later: Rank Math briefly replaced Yoast (Jul 8), then OTTO became the only SEO head; city pages moved to root slugs in August; llms.txt was later created and cleaned (Oct 8).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `seo-audit-alphalete-2026-06-23.md`: the full P0/P1/P2 fix list.
- `alphalete_aeo_audit.md`: per-page AEO/GEO grading table and detail.
- `alphalete_aeo_audit.py`: the grading script (no note).
